videos.topic: Prime Agent is a new kind of agent: instead of many fixed tools it has one tool that builds any tool it needs, the first agent that grows its own toolbox.
videos.redo: Miguel approved the split and the whiteboard. The cutout is REJECTED for two reasons. (1) THE CHAIR: the black chair wings are inside the cutout at both shoulders on every frame; matte_review.py auto-holds this matte (furniture on the silhouette, chair band p95 5,591 px, sheets under review/matte_primeagent/). Nobody ever reviewed this matte: the selection in matting/primeagent/selection.json was approved by a v3 agent that did not look, and the matte was tracked from it. Astra: review the frame-0 outline on the overlay, exclude the chair at BOTH shoulders and beside the head, keep him whole, approve as codex-astra; then, because this is a chair leak, SKIP the MatAnyone re-track and go straight to the chair lane fallback_sam2.py --run <run> --vid primeagent --tag fb1; look at the four sheets; hold for Miguel if chair remains. (2) THE LANES: the existing gen/primeagent_cutout_gen.py fades the depth lanes in at SC.BESPOKE[0]['t'] (8.2 s), leaving empty cream behind him for eight seconds. Cutout author: change that fade-in to the chassis intro at the start of the take (the lanes are there from frame 0), rebuild against the new matte, and re-render the cutout only. The design and the scene are final and sealed: the design agent keeps them and returns.
